text:
Ara: Heads-up — eu-west-3c prewarm pool is depleted and we're seeing a bunch of fast failovers to other AZs. Cross-AZ egress + tail latency increasing.
Devin: Any deploys or config pushes in 3c recently?
Maria: Not that I see. Looks like the cloud resize last week lowered our default prewarm target for c. Cost vs availability tradeoff. :thinking:
Ops-bot: ALERT: pool-prewarm-low eu-west-3c (gpus_available=6, targets=28)
Sam: Can someone run a quick reserve or bump warmers? We don't want user-facing tail latencies.
Ara: I ran a quick probe, output below:
```
# probe output
> rctl pool status --region eu-west-3 --az c --type prewarm
available: 6
reserved_inflight: 22
queued_requests: 14
avg_spinup_ms: 4500
cross_az_failovers_24h: 12
```
Lucy: Routing TTL is pretty short (30s) so any spinups that take >2s get failed over immediately. That creates extra egress and p99 spikes. We could bump routing_grace to 10s for short-seq tenants.
Devin: Soft-affinity helps but causes fragmentation with long-running reserved jobs. Two options: temporary reserve in 3c or shift warmers from 3a for a bit. What are the spillover costs?
Maria: Cross-AZ spillover adds ~0.08$/token on average + egress. For our top tenant that's ~2.3k/day at current volume. Reserving extra prewarm is cheaper if this persists more than ~8 hours.
Ara: @Sam can you do a one-off reserve while we adjust routing? I'll create a ticket after.
Sam: On it. Running: `rctl reserve-pool --region eu-west-3 --az c --gpus 22 --reason "temp prewarm for spike" --ttl 4h`
Ops-bot: JOB 6712 started by Sam — reserve-pool (eu-west-3c, 22 GPUs)
Sam: Done — reserve applied. new_available=28, reserved_inflight dropped to 0. Monitoring. :white_check_mark:
Lucy: I'm pushing a routing tweak: increase spinup_grace to 10s and set immediate_failover=false for tenancy classes small/latency-sensitive. Will bump back in 4h.
Ara: Great. Can we add a short postmortem so this doesn't recur? Autoscaler didn't react to the short burst pattern.
Devin: Created INC-4789 and assigned to infra-autoscale. :thumbsup:
Maria: Also propose a console alert: cross-AZ egress > 15% for 1h -> page infra oncall and open a scaling override. Saves money and prevents customer impact.
Ops-bot: INC-4789 created by Devin — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4789
Sam: Monitoring metrics look better. p95 tail down ~30%. I'll leave reserve until TTL expires unless we need it longer.
Ara: Thanks everyone. Follow-up in INC-4789 for next steps (autoscaler thresholds + prewarm defaults per AZ).
Lucy: +1 will add routing config change to the incident notes.
Maria: I'll run a cost simulation for a 24/48/72h reserve and post numbers in the ticket.
Devin: Closing loop — watch eu-west-3c for the next 6 hours, ping here if it regresses.
Ara: Pinged @oncall for visibility.
Sam: ack
